description: Two PreToolUse guards on Bash and PowerShell, so neither shell is a way around them. format-gate: blocks a commit when source files changed since the formatter last ran (formatting rewrites every mtime, so it runs once at the end, and this keeps it honest). bash-guard: blocks a force push without a lease, and a tree-wide formatter run that has not been acknowledged. One SessionStart check, compile-commands: tells Claude when a CMake checkout has no usable compile_commands.json at its root, so it does not trust a language server running on guessed flags.
